column1: # Census rows of group G3 (leaf L087, crate m3-linked-index-spliterator-20261019) re-run on the base of this branch (M3JDK master 48b67fdb6705624815f392ac68fe1796beb714f5) with census.py compare() via recensus.py; donor develop ca1aafc4d94f9dd1ee288226dcca070cc60991c9.
